nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based system for assisting medical diagnosis.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space, supporting query-by-cases and query-by-experts.

A common multidimensional space in which a new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so their similarities can be computed.<SEP>A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded as multidimensional representations.

A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space for comparison with existing cases and experts.<SEP>A case comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, received in a query request and embedded in the embedding space for diagnosis assistance.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates when a query-for-cases is selected.<SEP>A set of medical cases embedded in the embedding space, against which a new case is compared by similarity.

A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates when a query-for-experts is selected and who may attempt to provide a diagnosis for a communicated new case.<SEP>A set of experts each embedded in the embedding space based on information such as expert profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from available query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case to the diagnosis assistance system.

A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of existing cases is returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of experts is returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.<SEP>A cost computed for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts is different from and higher than the cost for a query-for-cases.

A set of medical concepts joined by links, used to compute multidimensional representations of medical cases and experts, with each concept corresponding to a dimension.<SEP>An ontology that includes parts of the human body, biological functions, medical conditions, pharmacological substances, and combinations thereof, and may be based on the Unified Medical Language System.
Concepts within the medical ontology, each corresponding to a respective dimension in the multidimensional representation.

A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.<SEP>A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing the similarity measure.
A processor used to perform at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.
One category of content included in the medical ontology, alongside biological functions, medical conditions, and pharmacological substances.
One category of content included in the medical ontology.
One category of content included in the medical ontology.
One category of content included in the medical ontology.
A medical ontology system on which the medical ontology used in the method is based.
A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor for executing them, used to receive query requests, embed new medical cases, and return subsets of cases or experts.
A set of devices in a network for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
Coded medical procedures which have been performed by an expert and used as information for embedding the expert.
Articles authored by an expert and used as information for embedding the expert.
A database from which documents are returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space.
A diagnosis formulated by a selected expert to whom the new case is provided.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis.
Records relating to a specific patient that may be included in the plurality of records of a new medical case.
Records relating to a specific patient that may be included in the plurality of records of a new medical case.
Descriptions of symptoms that may be included in the plurality of records of a new medical case.
Devices whose results may be included in the plurality of records of a new medical case.
Records of prescribed medications and treatments that may be included in the plurality of records of a new medical case.

edges.description: The patent publication describes a method for diagnosis assistance.
The diagnosis assistance method embeds a new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts in a common embedding space to exploit their similarity.
The method receives a query request including a new medical case and embeds the new medical case in the embedding space.
The method returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity with the embedded new case when a query-for-cases is selected.
The method returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity with the embedded new case when a query-for-experts is selected.
The method provides for the requester to select a query-for-cases among a plurality of query types.
The method provides for the requester to select a query-for-experts among a plurality of query types.
The method computes a cost for the query, with the cost differing between query-for-experts and query-for-cases.
The embedding of the new medical case, existing cases, and experts is based on a medical ontology.
At least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps is performed with a computer processor.
Each medical concept corresponds to a respective dimension in the multidimensional representation in the embedding space.
The new medical case is embedded in the embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are also embedded.
The set of existing medical cases is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
The requester submits a query request that includes the new medical case.

The matrix of proximities is applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case when computing similarity measures.<SEP>The matrix of proximities is applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case to account for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records that may include laboratory test results.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records that may include images.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records that may include descriptions of symptoms.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records that may include results of patient monitors.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records that may include prescribed medications and treatments.

The query-for-cases returns a subset of the existing medical cases based on computed similarity.<SEP>When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing cases is returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.
